function luminance(color) {
  const short = /^#([a-f\d])([a-f\d])([a-f\d])$/i.exec(color);
  const hex = short ? short.slice(1).map((part) => part + part).join("") : /^#([a-f\d]{6})(?:[a-f\d]{2})?$/i.exec(color)?.[1];
  if (!hex) return null;
  const [r, g, b] = [0, 2, 4].map((offset2) => {
    const channel = parseInt(hex.slice(offset2, offset2 + 2), 16) / 255;
    return channel <= 0.04045 ? channel / 12.92 : ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
  });
  return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b;
}
function contrast(a, b) {
  const x = luminance(a), y = luminance(b);
  return x === null || y === null ? 21 : (Math.max(x, y) + 0.05) / (Math.min(x, y) + 0.05);
}

}

function relativeTime(value, now = Date.now()) {
  if (value === null || value === void 0 || value === "") return "";
  const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  const time2 = date.getTime();
  if (!Number.isFinite(time2)) return "";
  const seconds = Math.round((now - time2) / 1e3);
  if (seconds < 45) return t("kitTime.justNow");
  if (seconds < 3600) return t("kitTime.minutesAgo", { count: Math.max(1, Math.round(seconds / 60)) });
  const today = new Date(now), sameDay = (a, b) => a.toDateString() === b.toDateString();
  const clock6 = `${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  if (sameDay(date, today)) return seconds < 6 * 3600 ? t("kitTime.hoursAgo", { count: Math.round(seconds / 3600) }) : t("kitTime.todayAt", { time: clock6 });
  const yesterday = new Date(now - 864e5);
  if (sameDay(date, yesterday)) return t("kitTime.yesterdayAt", { time: clock6 });
  const month = t("kitTime.months").split("|")[date.getMonth()] ?? String(date.getMonth() + 1);
  return date.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear() ? t("kitTime.monthDay", { month, day: date.getDate() }) : t("kitTime.yearMonthDay", { year: date.getFullYear(), month, day: date.getDate() });
}
function formatDuration(milliseconds) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(milliseconds) || milliseconds < 0) return "";
  const seconds = Math.round(milliseconds / 1e3);
  if (seconds < 60) return t("kitTime.seconds", { count: seconds });
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return seconds % 60 ? t("kitTime.minutesSeconds", { minutes, seconds: seconds % 60 }) : t("kitTime.minutes", { count: minutes });
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  return minutes % 60 ? t("kitTime.hoursMinutes", { hours, minutes: minutes % 60 }) : t("kitTime.hours", { count: hours });
}
function compactNumber(value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "";
  const abs = Math.abs(value);
  if (abs < 1e3) return String(Math.round(value));
  if (abs < 1e6) return `${(value / 1e3).toFixed(abs < 1e4 ? 1 : 0).replace(/\.0$/, "")}k`;
  return `${(value / 1e6).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "")}M`;
}

function chimeWav(kind) {
  const notes = NOTES[kind], buzz = kind === "error";
  let end = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < notes.length; index += 3) end = Math.max(end, notes[index + 1] + notes[index + 2]);

  for (let sample2 = 0; sample2 < count6; sample2++) {
    const time2 = sample2 / RATE;
    let value = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < notes.length; index += 3) {
      const at2 = time2 - notes[index + 1], length = notes[index + 2];
      if (at2 < 0 || at2 > length) continue;
      const phase = 2 * Math.PI * notes[index] * at2, level2 = Math.min(1, at2 / 5e-3, (length - at2) / 0.02) * Math.exp(-at2 * (buzz ? 8 : 5));
      value += level2 * (buzz ? Math.sin(phase) + Math.sin(3 * phase) / 3 + Math.sin(5 * phase) / 5 : Math.sin(phase) + Math.sin(2 * phase) / 4);
    }
    view.setInt16(44 + sample2 * 2, Math.round(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, value * 0.42)) * 32767), true);
  }
  const parts = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < bytes.length; index += 3) {
    const a = bytes[index], b = bytes[index + 1], c = bytes[index + 2], bits = a << 16 | (b ?? 0) << 8 | (c ?? 0);

  }
  return parts.join("");
}

function classifyAgentStatus(source, lifecycle) {
  const pending2 = source.pendingPermissions?.length ?? source.pendingPermissionCount ?? 0;
  const attentionAt = timestamp(source.attentionTimestamp);
  const latestPromptAt = Math.max(
    timestamp(source.lastUserMessageAt) ?? 0,
    timestamp(source.activeTurn?.startedAt) ?? 0,
    timestamp(lifecycle?.turnStartedAt) ?? 0
  );
  const attentionIsCurrent = attentionAt === null ? latestPromptAt === 0 : attentionAt >= latestPromptAt;
  if (pending2 > 0 || source.attentionReason === "permission" && source.requiresAttention !== false && attentionIsCurrent) return "waiting";
  if (source.status === "running") return "running";
  if (source.status === "initializing") return "initializing";
  if (source.status === "error") return "error";
  if (source.status === "canceled" || source.status === "cancelled") return "canceled";
  const asks = lifecycle?.replyAsks === true && (timestamp(lifecycle.replyAt) ?? -1) >= latestPromptAt;
  const settled = (status) => status === "completed" && asks ? "idle" : status;
  if (source.status === "completed") return settled("completed");
  const lifecycleResult = currentLifecycleOutcome(source, lifecycle);
  const attentionResult = attentionIsCurrent && source.attentionReason === "finished" ? "completed" : attentionIsCurrent && source.attentionReason === "error" && (source.requiresAttention !== false || source.archivedAt || source.status === "closed") ? "error" : null;
  if (lifecycleResult && (!attentionResult || attentionAt === null || lifecycleResult.at >= attentionAt)) return settled(lifecycleResult.status);
  if (attentionResult) return settled(attentionResult);
  if (source.status === "closed") return "closed";
  return source.status === "idle" ? asks ? "idle" : "quiet" : "initializing";
}

function applyTelemetry(agent, lifecycle) {
  if (!lifecycle || ["running", "waiting", "initializing"].includes(agent.status)) return agent;
  const stop = currentStop(agent, lifecycle), nudge = currentNudge(agent, lifecycle);
  const enriched = applyLifecycle(agent, lifecycle);
  const stopped = stop ? { ...enriched, stop } : enriched.stop ? { ...enriched, stop: null } : enriched;
  return nudge ? { ...stopped, replyNudge: nudge } : stopped.replyNudge ? { ...stopped, replyNudge: null } : stopped;
}
function applyLifecycle(agent, lifecycle) {
  const source = {
    status: agent.rawStatus,
    pendingPermissionCount: agent.pendingPermissionCount,
    createdAt: agent.createdAt,
    lastUserMessageAt: agent.lastUserMessageAt,
    activeTurn: agent.activeTurnStartedAt ? { startedAt: agent.activeTurnStartedAt } : null,
    attentionReason: agent.attentionReason,
    attentionTimestamp: agent.attentionTimestamp,
    requiresAttention: agent.requiresAttention,
    archivedAt: agent.archivedAt
  };
  const status = classifyAgentStatus(source, lifecycle);
  const outcome = currentLifecycleOutcome(source, lifecycle);
  const turnStartedAt = validDate(lifecycle.turnStartedAt), turnEndedAt = validDate(lifecycle.turnEndedAt);
  const observed = agent.observedTurnStartedAt === turnStartedAt && agent.observedTurnEndedAt === turnEndedAt ? agent : { ...agent, observedTurnStartedAt: turnStartedAt, observedTurnEndedAt: turnEndedAt };
  if (status === "idle") {
    const execution2 = latestDate([agent.lastExecutionAt, agent.lastUserMessageAt, lifecycle.turnStartedAt, lifecycle.replyAt, outcome ? lifecycle.turnEndedAt : null]);
    return { ...observed, status, completionAt: null, lastExecutionAt: execution2, lastActivityAt: agent.archivedAt ? execution2 ?? agent.lastActivityAt : latestDate([execution2, agent.lastActivityAt]) };
  }
  const existingCompletion = timestamp(completionOf(agent, false));
  if (existingCompletion !== null && outcome && outcome.at < existingCompletion) return observed;
  const sameKnownTurn = existingCompletion !== null && (timestamp(lifecycle.turnStartedAt) ?? 0) <= existingCompletion;
  const completionAt = status === "completed" ? nativeCompletionTimestamp(observed) ?? (sameKnownTurn ? completionOf(agent, false) : null) ?? validDate(outcome?.status === "completed" ? lifecycle.turnEndedAt : null) : null;
  const execution = latestDate([
    agent.lastExecutionAt,
    agent.lastUserMessageAt,
    agent.activeTurnStartedAt,
    agent.attentionTimestamp,
    lifecycle.turnStartedAt,
    outcome ? lifecycle.turnEndedAt : null
  ]);
  const activity = agent.archivedAt ? execution ?? agent.lastActivityAt : latestDate([execution, agent.lastActivityAt]);
  const result = status === observed.status && execution === observed.lastExecutionAt && activity === observed.lastActivityAt && completionAt === observed.completionAt ? observed : { ...observed, status, completionAt, lastExecutionAt: execution, lastActivityAt: activity };
  if (existingCompletion !== null && (timestamp(lifecycle.turnStartedAt) ?? 0) > existingCompletion) return result;
  return preserveCompletionEvidence(agent, result);
}

function contextPressure(usage) {
  const { contextUsed: used, contextTotal: total } = usage;
  if (used === null || total === null || !(total > 0) || !(used >= 0)) return null;
  const share2 = used / total;
  return share2 >= 0.85 ? { percent: Math.min(100, Math.round(share2 * 100)), level: share2 >= 0.95 ? "critical" : "high" } : null;
}
function formatTokens(value) {
  if (value == null || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return "\u2014";
  if (value >= 1e6) return `${(value / 1e6).toFixed(value >= 1e7 ? 0 : 1)}M`;
  if (value >= 1e3) return `${(value / 1e3).toFixed(value >= 1e5 ? 0 : 1)}k`;
  return Math.floor(value).toLocaleString();
}

function mergeToolItems(earlier, later) {

function mergeSourceRanges(a, b) {
  const ranges = [
    ...a.sourceRanges ?? [{ startSeq: a.seqStart, endSeq: a.seqEnd }],
    ...b.sourceRanges ?? [{ startSeq: b.seqStart, endSeq: b.seqEnd }]
  ].sort((left, right) => left.startSeq - right.startSeq);
  const output = [];
  for (const range of ranges) {
    const last = output[output.length - 1];
    if (last && range.startSeq <= last.endSeq + 1) last.endSeq = Math.max(last.endSeq, range.endSeq);
    else output.push({ ...range });
  }
  return output;
}
function mergeToolRows(a, b) {
  const [earlier, later] = a.seqEnd <= b.seqEnd ? [a, b] : [b, a];

    seqEnd: Math.max(a.seqEnd, b.seqEnd),
    sourceRanges: mergeSourceRanges(a, b),
    item: mergeToolItems(earlier.item, later.item)
  };
}

function normalizeTimelinePage(value) {

  };

function reconcileTimelinePage(previous, incoming, direction = "tail") {
  const sameEpoch = previous?.epoch === incoming.epoch;
  const previousRows = sameEpoch && !incoming.reset ? previous.rows : [];
  const minSeq = incoming.rows.length ? Math.min(...incoming.rows.map((row) => row.seqStart)) : Infinity;
  const rangesOverlap = (a, b) => (a.sourceRanges?.length ? a.sourceRanges : [{ startSeq: a.seqStart, endSeq: a.seqEnd }]).some((left) => (b.sourceRanges?.length ? b.sourceRanges : [{ startSeq: b.seqStart, endSeq: b.seqEnd }]).some((right) => left.startSeq <= right.endSeq && right.startSeq <= left.endSeq));
  const retained = previousRows.filter((row) => !incoming.rows.some((next) => {
    if (next.item.type !== row.item.type) return false;
    const identity = rowIdentity(row);
    if (identity || rowIdentity(next)) return identity === rowIdentity(next);
    if (row.turnId !== next.turnId) return false;
    const messageId = string(row.item.messageId), nextMessageId = string(next.item.messageId);
    if (messageId && nextMessageId && messageId !== nextMessageId) return false;
    return rangesOverlap(row, next);
  }));
  const byIdentity = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const previousItems = new Map(previousRows.filter((row) => rowIdentity(row)).map((row) => [rowIdentity(row), row]));
  for (const row of [...retained, ...incoming.rows]) {
    const identity = rowIdentity(row) ?? `seq:${row.seqStart}`;
    const prior = byIdentity.get(identity) ?? previousItems.get(identity);
    if (prior && row.item.type === "tool_call") {
      byIdentity.set(identity, mergeToolRows(prior, row));
    } else if (prior && prior.seqEnd > row.seqEnd) {
      byIdentity.set(identity, prior);
    } else {
      byIdentity.set(identity, prior && itemIdentity(row.item) ? { ...row, seqStart: Math.min(prior.seqStart, row.seqStart) } : row);
    }
  }
  const allRows = [...byIdentity.values()].sort((a, b) => a.seqStart - b.seqStart || a.seqEnd - b.seqEnd);
  const truncated = allRows.length > MAX_TIMELINE_ROWS;
  const rows = truncated ? direction === "before" ? allRows.slice(0, MAX_TIMELINE_ROWS) : allRows.slice(-MAX_TIMELINE_ROWS) : allRows;
  const preserveOlder = sameEpoch && !incoming.reset && direction === "tail" && !!previous.startCursor && previous.startCursor.seq <= minSeq;
  const preserveNewer = sameEpoch && !incoming.reset && direction === "before";
  return {
    ...incoming,
    rows,
    startCursor: rows.length ? { epoch: incoming.epoch, seq: rows[0].seqStart } : incoming.startCursor,
    endCursor: rows.length ? { epoch: incoming.epoch, seq: Math.max(...rows.map((row) => row.seqEnd)) } : incoming.endCursor,
    hasOlder: truncated && direction === "tail" || (preserveOlder ? previous.hasOlder : incoming.hasOlder),
    hasNewer: truncated && direction === "before" || (preserveNewer ? previous.hasNewer : incoming.hasNewer),
    gap: incoming.gap || sameEpoch && previous.gap,
    truncated: truncated || incoming.truncated
  };
}

// shared/attention.ts
function attentionPhase(agent) {
  const waiting = waitingKind(agent);
  if (waiting) return waiting;
  if (stopShown(agent)) return agent.stop.kind;
  if (agent.status === "error") return "error";
  if (agent.status === "idle") return "idle";
  return isUnreadCompletion(agent) ? "unread" : null;
}
function sessionPhase(agent, snoozed = false) {
  const waiting = waitingKind(agent);
  if (waiting) return waiting;
  if (stopShown(agent)) return agent.stop.kind;
  if (agent.status === "error") return "error";
  if (agent.status === "running") return "running";
  if (agent.status === "initializing") return "starting";
  if (agent.status === "completed") return isUnreadCompletion(agent) ? snoozed ? "snoozed" : "unread" : "done";
  return agent.status === "canceled" ? "canceled" : agent.status === "closed" ? "closed" : agent.status === "idle" ? "idle" : "quiet";
}

};

function clockLabel(value, now = Date.now()) {
  const at2 = new Date(value), today = new Date(now);
  if (!Number.isFinite(at2.getTime())) return t2("sharedAttention.m001");
  const time2 = `${two(at2.getHours())}:${two(at2.getMinutes())}`;
  const midnight = (date) => new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()).getTime();
  const days3 = Math.round((midnight(at2) - midnight(today)) / 864e5);
  return days3 === 0 ? time2 : days3 === 1 ? t2("sharedAttention.m002", { time: time2 }) : days3 === -1 ? t2("sharedAttention.m003", { time: time2 }) : t2("sharedAttention.m004", { value1: at2.getMonth() + 1, value2: at2.getDate(), time: time2 });
}
function reasonText(input, now = Date.now()) {
  const first = input.pending?.[0];
  switch (input.phase) {
    case "question": {
      const options = first?.options.length ? t2("sharedAttention.m005", { value1: first.options.slice(0, 3).join(" / "), value2: first.options.length > 3 ? " \u2026" : "" }) : "";
      return { text: t2("sharedAttention.m006", { value1: first?.title ?? t2("sharedAttention.m007"), options }), hue: "violet", icon: "MessageCircleQuestion" };
    }
    case "plan":
      return { text: t2("sharedAttention.m008", { value1: first?.title ?? t2("sharedAttention.m009") }), hue: "amber", icon: "ClipboardList" };
    case "approval": {
      const tool = input.pending?.find((request) => request.kind === "tool") ?? first, count6 = input.pendingCount ?? input.pending?.length ?? 0;
      const what = tool?.detail ? t2("sharedAttention.m010", { value1: tool.detail }) : tool?.title ? t2("sharedAttention.m011", { value1: tool.title }) : t2("sharedAttention.m012");
      return { text: count6 > 1 ? t2("sharedAttention.m013", { what, count: count6 }) : what, hue: "amber", icon: "Hand" };
    }
    // A reset the notice gave without a time zone is read in the device's zone: about then, not exactly (grok-F2).
    case "quota":
      return { text: input.stop?.resetAt ? t2("sharedAttention.m014", { value1: input.stop.resetGuessed ? t2("sharedAttention.m015") : "", value2: clockLabel(input.stop.resetAt, now), value3: input.stop.resetGuessed ? t2("sharedAttention.m016") : "" }) : t2("sharedAttention.m017"), hue: "orange", icon: "BatteryWarning" };
    case "error":
      return { text: t2("sharedAttention.m018", { value1: firstLine(input.lastError) ?? t2("sharedAttention.m019") }), hue: "red", icon: "CircleX" };
    case "silent":
      return { text: t2("sharedAttention.m020"), hue: "amber", icon: "CircleDashed" };
    case "unfinished":
      return { text: input.stop?.closedMidTurn ? t2("sharedAttention.m021") : t2("sharedAttention.m022"), hue: "amber", icon: "CircleDotDashed" };
    case "idle":
      return { text: input.note ? t2("sharedAttention.m023", { value1: input.note }) : t2("sharedAttention.m024"), hue: "violet", icon: "MessageCircleMore" };
    case "unread":
      return { text: input.note ? t2("sharedAttention.m025", { value1: input.note }) : t2("sharedAttention.m026"), hue: "pink", icon: "Mail" };
  }
}

function threadAttention(node, attention) {
  let count6 = 0, unread = 0, phase = null;
  const stack = [...node.children];
  while (stack.length) {
    const child = stack.pop();
    stack.push(...child.children);
    if (attention(child.agent)) {
      count6++;
      const own = attentionPhase(child.agent) ?? "unread";
      if (phase === null || ATTENTION_PHASES.indexOf(own) < ATTENTION_PHASES.indexOf(phase)) phase = own;
    } else if (isUnreadCompletion(child.agent)) unread++;
  }
  return { count: count6, phase, unread };
}

function applyLiveExtras(agents, extras) {
  if (!extras?.length) return agents;
  const byId = new Map(extras.map((extra) => [extra.agentId, extra]));
  return agents.map((agent) => {
    const extra = byId.get(agent.id);
    if (!extra) return agent;
    const prompt = Math.max(timestamp(agent.lastUserMessageAt) ?? 0, timestamp(agent.activeTurnStartedAt) ?? 0);
    const note = extra.note && (timestamp(extra.noteAt) ?? 0) >= prompt ? extra.note : null;
    const todo = extra.todo && agent.status === "running" ? extra.todo : null;
    const ask = extra.ask && (timestamp(extra.askAt) ?? 0) >= prompt ? extra.ask : null;
    return note || todo || ask ? { ...agent, ...note ? { note } : {}, ...todo ? { todo } : {}, ...ask ? { replyAsk: ask } : {} } : agent;
  });
}

var SETTLED = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["idle", "completed", "quiet", "canceled"]);
function applyBackground(agent, background) {
  if (!background || background.running < 1 || agent.archivedAt) return agent;
  const settled = SETTLED.has(agent.status);
  if (!settled && agent.status !== "running") return agent;
  const activity = (timestamp(background.updatedAt) ?? 0) > (timestamp(agent.lastActivityAt) ?? 0) ? background.updatedAt : agent.lastActivityAt;
  return { ...agent, ...settled ? { status: "running" } : {}, background, lastActivityAt: activity };
}
function enrichAgents(agents, telemetry, background) {
  if (!telemetry && !background?.agents.length) return agents;
  const records = new Map((telemetry?.agents ?? []).map((item) => [item.agentId, item]));
  const working = new Map((background?.agents ?? []).map((item) => [item.agentId, item]));
  return agents.map((agent) => {
    const record = records.get(agent.id), enriched = applyTelemetry(agent, record);
    return applyBackground(record?.link ? { ...enriched, changeRequest: record.link } : enriched, working.get(agent.id));
  });
}

function needsAttention(agent, snoozed = false, options = {}) {
  if (agent.archivedAt) return false;
  if (agent.pendingPermissionCount > 0 || agent.status === "waiting") return true;
  if (stopShown(agent)) return stopUnseen(agent);

  if (agent.parentAgentId && options.childCompletions !== true) return false;

  return !snoozed && (isUnreadCompletion(agent) || unreadQuestion);
}

function groupDashboardRows(rows, attention) {
  const sections = new Map(["attention", "running", "recent"].map((group) => [group, { group, rows: [], threads: 0 }]));
  let current2;
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.depth === 0 || !current2) {
      let group = "recent";
      const stack = [row.node];
      while (stack.length && group !== "attention") {
        const node = stack.pop();
        if (attention(node.agent)) group = "attention";
        else if (live(node.agent)) group = "running";
        stack.push(...node.children);
      }
      current2 = sections.get(group);
      current2.threads++;
    }
    current2.rows.push(row);
  }
  return [...sections.values()].filter((section) => section.rows.length > 0);
}

function historyActivityTimestamp(agent) {

  const markers = [agent.lastExecutionAt, agent.lastUserMessageAt, agent.activeTurnStartedAt, agent.attentionTimestamp].map(timestamp).filter((value) => value !== null);

  const archiveTime = timestamp(agent.archivedAt);
  const retained = [agent.lastActivityAt, agent.updatedAt].map(timestamp).filter((value) => value !== null && archiveTime !== null && value < archiveTime);
  return retained.length ? Math.max(...retained) : timestamp(agent.createdAt);
}
function pinned(agent) {
  if (agent.archivedAt) return false;
  if (["running", "waiting", "initializing"].includes(agent.status) || isUnreadCompletion(agent) || stopUnseen(agent)) return true;
  return agent.status === "error" ? agent.requiresAttention !== false : agent.requiresAttention === true && agent.status === "idle";
}
function withinRange(agent, range = DEFAULT_TIME_RANGE, now = Date.now()) {
  if (range === "all") return true;
  if (pinned(agent)) return true;
  if (!Number.isFinite(now)) return false;
  const since = now - (range === "24h" ? 1 : range === "7d" ? 7 : 30) * 864e5;
  const time2 = historyActivityTimestamp(agent);
  return time2 !== null && time2 >= since && time2 <= now;
}

function nextRangeChange(agents, range, now) {

    if (time2 + span + 1 > now) next = Math.min(next, time2 + span + 1);
  }
  return next;
}

// shared/decision-signals.ts
function decisionSignals(agents, events, now = Date.now()) {
  const signals = [], failuresByAgent = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const event of events) if (event.type === "turn_failed" && (timestamp(event.at) ?? 0) >= now - 864e5) {
    const list = failuresByAgent.get(event.agentId);
    if (list) list.push(event);
    else failuresByAgent.set(event.agentId, [event]);
  }
  for (const agent of agents) {
    if (agent.archivedAt) continue;
    if (isUnreadCompletion(agent)) {
      const since = knownCompletionAt(agent);
      if ((timestamp(since) ?? now) <= now - 15 * 6e4) signals.push({ kind: "unread", agentId: agent.id, title: agent.title, since, count: 1 });
    }
    if (agent.status === "waiting") {
      const since = agent.attentionReason === "permission" ? agent.attentionTimestamp ?? agent.activeTurnStartedAt : null;
      signals.push({ kind: "permission", agentId: agent.id, title: agent.title, since, count: agent.pendingPermissionCount });
    }
    if (agent.status === "running" && (timestamp(agent.lastActivityAt) ?? now) <= now - 30 * 6e4) signals.push({ kind: "quiet", agentId: agent.id, title: agent.title, since: agent.lastActivityAt, count: 1 });
    const failures = failuresByAgent.get(agent.id) ?? [];
    if (failures.length >= 2) signals.push({ kind: "repeated_failure", agentId: agent.id, title: agent.title, since: failures.at(-1)?.at ?? null, count: failures.length });
  }
  return signals.sort((a, b) => (a.kind === "permission" ? -1 : 1) - (b.kind === "permission" ? -1 : 1) || (timestamp(a.since) ?? now) - (timestamp(b.since) ?? now));
}

function snoozeToken(agent) {
  if (agent.status === "idle" && !agent.archivedAt && agent.requiresAttention === true && agent.attentionReason === "finished") {
    const stamp2 = timestamp(agent.attentionTimestamp), prompt = timestamp(agent.lastUserMessageAt), started = timestamp(agent.observedTurnStartedAt);
    if (stamp2 !== null && started !== null && started > stamp2 && (prompt === null || started > prompt)) return agent.observedTurnStartedAt ?? null;
    return prompt !== null && (stamp2 === null || prompt > stamp2) ? agent.lastUserMessageAt : agent.attentionTimestamp ?? null;
  }
  return knownCompletionAt(agent);
}
function isCompletionSnoozed(agent, snoozes, now = Date.now()) {
  const completionAt = snoozeToken(agent);
  if (!completionAt) return false;
  const token = Date.parse(completionAt);
  return snoozes.some((snooze) => snooze.agentId === agent.id && Date.parse(snooze.completionAt) === token && Date.parse(snooze.until) > now);
}
function nextSnoozeExpiry(snoozes, now) {
  let next = Infinity;
  for (const snooze of snoozes) {
    const until = Date.parse(snooze.until);
    if (until > now) next = Math.min(next, until);
  }
  return next;
}

function mergeAnalytics(previous, response) {

}
function emptyActivityMetrics() {
  return {
    eventCount: 0,
    started: 0,
    completed: 0,
    failed: 0,
    canceled: 0,
    runMs: 0,
    runSamples: 0,
    waitMs: 0,
    inputTokens: null,
    outputTokens: null,
    cachedTokens: null,
    costUsd: null,
    usageSamples: 0
  };
}
function sumActivityMetrics(rows) {
  const result = emptyActivityMetrics();
  for (const row of rows) {
    for (const key of ["eventCount", "started", "completed", "failed", "canceled", "runMs", "runSamples", "waitMs", "usageSamples"]) result[key] += row[key];
    for (const key of ["inputTokens", "outputTokens", "cachedTokens", "costUsd"]) {
      if (row[key] !== null) result[key] = result[key] === null ? row[key] : Math.max(result[key], row[key]);
    }
  }
  return result;
}
function analyticsOffsetAt(zone2, at2) {
  const offsets = zone2?.offsets;
  if (!offsets?.length) return 0;
  let minutes = offsets[0][1];

    if (from > at2) break;
    minutes = value;
  }
  return minutes * 6e4;
}
var analyticsLocalDay = (at2, zone2) => Math.floor((at2 + analyticsOffsetAt(zone2, at2)) / DAY_MS);

}

function coveredDuration(intervals, from, to) {
  if (to <= from) return 0;
  const ranges = intervals.map((interval) => [Math.max(from, Date.parse(interval.start)), Math.min(to, Date.parse(interval.end))]).filter(([start, end2]) => Number.isFinite(start) && Number.isFinite(end2) && end2 > start).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  let total = 0, end = -Infinity;
  for (const [start, stop] of ranges) {
    total += Math.max(0, stop - Math.max(start, end));
    end = Math.max(end, stop);
  }
  return total;
}
function buildHourlyHeatmap(hours, options = {}) {
  const now = options.now ?? Date.now(), zone2 = options.zone ?? null;
  const days3 = Math.min(HEATMAP_DAYS, Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.days ?? HEATMAP_DAYS)));
  const today = analyticsLocalDay(now, zone2), first = today - (days3 - 1);
  const observedSince = options.startedAt ? Date.parse(options.startedAt) : -Infinity;
  const hourlySince = options.hourlyFrom ? Date.parse(options.hourlyFrom) : -Infinity;
  const currentHour = Math.floor(now / HOUR_MS) * HOUR_MS;
  const buckets = new Map(hours.map((bucket) => [Date.parse(bucket.bucketStart), bucket]));
  const slots = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (let at2 = analyticsDayStart(first, zone2), end = analyticsDayStart(today + 1, zone2); at2 < end; at2 += HOUR_MS) {
    const key = `${analyticsDayText(analyticsLocalDay(at2, zone2))}:${analyticsLocalHour(at2, zone2)}`;
    slots.set(key, [...slots.get(key) ?? [], at2]);
  }
  const metric = options.metric ?? "eventCount";
  const additive = !["inputTokens", "outputTokens", "cachedTokens", "costUsd"].includes(metric);
  return Array.from({ length: days3 * 24 }, (_, index) => {
    const day3 = analyticsDayText(first + Math.floor(index / 24)), hour2 = index % 24, key = `${day3}:${hour2}`, starts = slots.get(key) ?? [];
    const firstAt = starts[0];
    if (firstAt === void 0) return { key, day: day3, hour: hour2, minute: 0, bucketStart: null, utcHours: 0, exists: false, observed: false, isFuture: false, value: null, metrics: null, coverage: "none", coveredMs: null };
    const found = starts.flatMap((at2) => {
      const bucket = buckets.get(at2);
      return bucket ? [bucket] : [];
    });
    const metrics = found.length ? { ...sumActivityMetrics(found), bucketStart: new Date(firstAt).toISOString() } : null;
    const isFuture = firstAt > currentHour;
    const span = starts.reduce((sum, at2) => sum + Math.max(0, Math.min(HOUR_MS, now - at2)), 0);
    const coveredMs = options.coverageIntervals === void 0 ? null : starts.reduce((sum, at2) => sum + coveredDuration(options.coverageIntervals, at2, Math.min(at2 + HOUR_MS, now)), 0);
    const observed = !isFuture && firstAt >= hourlySince && (coveredMs === null ? starts.at(-1) + HOUR_MS > observedSince : coveredMs > 0);
    const coverage = coveredMs === null ? "unknown" : coveredMs <= 0 ? "none" : coveredMs >= span - 1 ? "full" : "partial";
    return {
      key,
      day: day3,
      hour: hour2,
      minute: new Date(firstAt + analyticsOffsetAt(zone2, firstAt)).getUTCMinutes(),
      bucketStart: new Date(firstAt).toISOString(),
      utcHours: starts.length,
      exists: true,
      observed,
      isFuture,
      coverage,
      coveredMs,
      value: observed ? metrics?.[metric] ?? (additive ? 0 : null) : null,
      metrics
    };
  });
}
function buildDailySeries(analytics, options = {}) {
  const now = options.now ?? Date.now(), zone2 = analytics.zone ?? null, count6 = Math.min(ANALYTICS_DAYS, Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.count ?? ANALYTICS_DAYS)));
  const today = analyticsLocalDay(now, zone2), buckets = new Map(analytics.days.map((bucket) => [bucket.day ?? bucket.bucketStart.slice(0, 10), bucket]));
  return Array.from({ length: count6 }, (_, index) => {
    const number = today - (count6 - 1) + index, day3 = analyticsDayText(number), start = analyticsDayStart(number, zone2), end = analyticsDayStart(number + 1, zone2);
    const coveredMs = coveredDuration(analytics.coverageIntervals ?? [], start, Math.min(end, now)), bucket = buckets.get(day3) ?? null;
    return { day: day3, start, end, observed: coveredMs > 0, coveredMs, bucket, approximate: bucket?.approximate === true };
  });
}

var import_plugin11 = require("@getpaseo/plugin");
var import_zod11 = require("zod");
var timestamp2 = import_zod11.z.iso.datetime({ offset: true });
var readReceiptSchema = import_zod11.z.object({
  agentId: import_zod11.z.string().min(1).max(512),
  completionAt: timestamp2,
  lastUserMessageAt: timestamp2.nullable(),
  readAt: timestamp2

var archiveReadOriginSchema = import_zod11.z.object({
  agentId: import_zod11.z.string().min(1).max(512),
  archivedAt: timestamp2,
  lastUserMessageAt: timestamp2.nullable()
});
var markCompletionRead = (0, import_plugin11.defineRpc)({
  name: "observatory.read-state.mark",
  // `error`: acknowledge a failed turn or a stop (知道了). It clears native attention like opening the Agent in Paseo, and
  // records no completion receipt. Without `kind` it is a finished turn or a question (标记已读).
  // `attentionTimestamp` is the host's own token, checked and cleared. It is null for a turn the host closed mid-way, which
  // raised no attention; `stopAt` (with `error`) then names the stop the server observed, and 知道了 is recorded on it.
  // `completionAt` is the completion the page shows as unread: after another prompt, or a heartbeat's turn (which leaves the
  // prompt as it was), the host's token still names an older, unread one (it is edge-triggered), so the receipt is stored for
  // exactly the newer turn's observed end once the server has verified it; a claim of an older turn is stale (codex-F5,
  // codex-obs-attn-F1).
  // An Agent the host has not loaded is never loaded for this (clearing would load it; an ACP one cannot be loaded at all):
  // the host's token is then only checked, and a receipt here for that token is what marks it (P2-3, P2-4): a result read, a
  // reply that asks opened, a failure seen (知道了, which also records its stop). `rearm`: a quick reply about to be sent,
  // which loads the Agent anyway, clears it first regardless, so the turn the reply starts is announced when it ends.
  // `round`: the turn whose reply asks the user (待回复), as the page saw it start and end. A heartbeat's next round asks again
  // with the host's prompt and attention tokens unchanged, so the server marks it read only while the turn it observed last is
  // still this one (codex-obs-attn-R2); a page left on an earlier round's question gets stale. A quick reply's `rearm` names
  // the round it answers by its start alone (codex-obs-attn-R4): nothing is cleared once another round has begun since, or
  // when the plugin's own record of the rounds cannot be read.
  input: import_zod11.z.object({
    agentId: import_zod11.z.string().min(1).max(512),
    attentionTimestamp: timestamp2.nullable(),
    lastUserMessageAt: timestamp2.nullable(),
    kind: import_zod11.z.enum(["completion", "error"]).optional(),
    completionAt: timestamp2.optional(),
    stopAt: timestamp2.optional(),
    rearm: import_zod11.z.boolean().optional(),
    round: import_zod11.z.object({ startedAt: timestamp2.nullable(), endedAt: timestamp2.nullable().optional() }).optional()
  }),
  output: import_zod11.z.object({
    agentId: import_zod11.z.string(),
    status: import_zod11.z.enum(["read", "stale", "not_unread", "failed"]),
    receipt: readReceiptSchema.nullable(),
    message: import_zod11.z.string()
  })
});

function heartbeatGuard(state, failed = false) {

function cronField(source, [min, max]) {
  const parts = source.split(","), values = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  let step = null, range = null;
  for (const raw of parts) {
    const part = raw.trim(), pieces = part.split("/");
    if (!part || pieces.length > 2) return null;
    const [base, stepText] = pieces;
    const by = stepText === void 0 ? 1 : Number.parseInt(stepText.trim(), 10);
    if (!Number.isInteger(by) || by <= 0 || stepText !== void 0 && String(by) !== stepText.trim()) return null;
    let from = min, to = max, stride = by;
    if (base !== "*") {
      const match = /^(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?$/.exec(base);
      if (!match) return null;
      from = Number(match[1]);
      to = match[2] === void 0 ? from : Number(match[2]);
      if (from > to || from < min || to > max) return null;
      if (match[2] === void 0) stride = 1;
      else if (parts.length === 1 && by === 1) range = [from, to];
    } else if (parts.length === 1 && by > 1) step = by;
    for (let value = from; value <= to; value += stride) values.add(value);
  }
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return { values: sorted, all: sorted.length === max - min + 1, step, range };
}
function parseCron(expression) {
  const fields = expression.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (fields.length !== 5) return null;
  const parsed = fields.map((field, index) => cronField(field, CRON_BOUNDS[index]));
  if (parsed.some((field) => !field)) return null;
  const [minute, hour2, day3, month, weekday] = parsed;
  return { minute, hour: hour2, day: day3, month, weekday };
}

}

    if (filter.scheduleId !== "all" && run.scheduleId !== filter.scheduleId) return false;
    if (filter.status !== "all" && run.status !== filter.status) return false;
    if (!words.length) return true;
    const haystack = runSearchText(run);
    return words.every((word) => haystack.includes(word));
  });
}
function describeRunError(error) {
  if (!error?.trim()) return null;
  const detail = error.replace(/^Internal error:\s*/i, "").split(/\n\s*\n|\s+\|\s+code=/)[0].replace(/\s*code:\s*-?\d+\s*$/i, "").trim() || error.trim();
  const known = [
    [/Working directory (.+) (?:no longer exists|is not a directory)/, (match) => t2("sharedSchedules.m082", { value1: match[1] })],
    [/is waiting for permission/, () => t2("sharedSchedules.m083")],
    [/Daemon restarted before the scheduled run completed/, () => t2("sharedSchedules.m084")],
    [/Timed out refreshing (.+?) after \d+ms/, (match) => t2("sharedSchedules.m085", { value1: match[1] })],
    [/already has an active run/, () => t2("sharedSchedules.m086")],
    [/does not support ACP session resume/, () => t2("sharedSchedules.m087")],
    [/was canceled/, () => t2("sharedSchedules.m088")],
    [/Agent \S+ (?:no longer exists|is archived)/, () => t2("sharedSchedules.m089")]
  ];
  for (const [pattern, summarize] of known) {
    const match = pattern.exec(detail);
    if (match) return { summary: summarize(match), detail, known: true };
  }
  return { summary: detail.split("\n")[0].slice(0, 200), detail, known: false };
}
function knownRunError(error) {
  const described = describeRunError(error);
  return described?.known ? described.summary : null;
}

function observedParallelism(daily, peak) {
  const tracked = daily.filter((day3) => day3.busyMs > 0), days3 = tracked.length > 1 ? tracked.slice(1) : tracked;
  const ratio = parallelism({ runMs: days3.reduce((sum, day3) => sum + day3.runMs, 0), busyMs: days3.reduce((sum, day3) => sum + day3.busyMs, 0) });
  return ratio !== null && (peak <= 0 || ratio <= peak + 0.05) ? ratio : null;
}
function bigNumber(value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "\u2014";
  const abs = Math.abs(value), chinese = currentLanguage() === "zh-CN";
  if (abs < (chinese ? 1e4 : 1e3)) return Math.round(value).toLocaleString("en-US");
  if (abs < (chinese ? 1e8 : 1e6)) return t2("sharedStatsView.m001", { value1: (value / (chinese ? 1e4 : 1e3)).toFixed(abs < 1e5 ? 1 : 0).replace(/\.0$/, "") });
  return t2("sharedStatsView.m002", { value1: (value / (chinese ? 1e8 : 1e6)).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "") });
}
function shortHours(milliseconds) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(milliseconds) || milliseconds <= 0) return "0";
  const minutes = milliseconds / 6e4;
  if (minutes < 1) return t2("sharedStatsView.m003", { value1: Math.round(milliseconds / 1e3) });
  if (minutes < 60) return t2("sharedStatsView.m004", { value1: Math.round(minutes) });
  const hours = minutes / 60;
  return t2("sharedStatsView.m005", { value1: hours < 10 ? hours.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "") : Math.round(hours).toLocaleString("en-US") });
}
var percent = (value, digits = 0) => value === null || !Number.isFinite(value) ? "\u2014" : `${(value * 100).toFixed(digits)}%`;

var nextDay = (day3, offset2) => new Date(Date.parse(`${day3}T00:00:00.000Z`) + offset2 * 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
function weekdayForecast(daily, pick, days3 = 7) {
  const recent = daily.slice(-28);
  if (!recent.length || recent.filter((day3) => pick(day3) > 0).length < 7) return [];
  const sums = Array(7).fill(0), counts = Array(7).fill(0);
  for (const day3 of recent) {
    const weekday = weekdayOf(day3.day);
    sums[weekday] += pick(day3);
    counts[weekday]++;
  }
  const last = recent.at(-1).day;
  return Array.from({ length: days3 }, (_, index) => {
    const day3 = nextDay(last, index + 1), weekday = weekdayOf(day3);
    return { day: day3, value: counts[weekday] ? sums[weekday] / counts[weekday] : 0 };
  });
}
function peakOf(values) {
  let best = -1;
  values.forEach((value, index) => {
    if (value > 0 && (best < 0 || value > values[best])) best = index;
  });
  return best < 0 ? null : { index: best, value: values[best] };
}

}

function Triangle({ a, b, c, color }) {
  const sides2 = [[a, b, c], [b, c, a], [c, a, b]];
  let [p, q, apex] = sides2.reduce((best, side) => Math.hypot(side[1].x - side[0].x, side[1].y - side[0].y) > Math.hypot(best[1].x - best[0].x, best[1].y - best[0].y) ? side : best);
  let angle = Math.atan2(q.y - p.y, q.x - p.x);
  if ((apex.x - p.x) * Math.sin(angle) - (apex.y - p.y) * Math.cos(angle) < 0) {
    [p, q] = [q, p];
    angle = Math.atan2(q.y - p.y, q.x - p.x);
  }
  const base = Math.hypot(q.x - p.x, q.y - p.y);
  if (base < 0.5) return null;
  const along = ((apex.x - p.x) * (q.x - p.x) + (apex.y - p.y) * (q.y - p.y)) / base, height = Math.abs(((q.x - p.x) * (apex.y - p.y) - (q.y - p.y) * (apex.x - p.x)) / base);
  if (height < 0.5) return null;
  return /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime6.jsx)(import_react_native9.View, { style: {
    position: "absolute",
    left: p.x,
    top: p.y - height,
    width: 0,
    height: 0,
    borderStyle: "solid",
    borderLeftWidth: Math.max(0, along),
    borderRightWidth: Math.max(0, base - along),
    borderBottomWidth: height,
    borderLeftColor: "transparent",
    borderRightColor: "transparent",
    borderBottomColor: color,
    transformOrigin: "0% 100%",
    transform: [{ rotate: `${angle * 180 / Math.PI}deg` }]
  } });
}

}
function useClock(intervalMs) {
  const foreground = useForeground();
  const [now, setNow] = (0, import_react12.useState)(Date.now());
  (0, import_react12.useEffect)(() => {
    if (!foreground) return;
    setNow(Date.now());
    const timer = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), intervalMs);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [foreground, intervalMs]);
  return now;
}

function createHitJumper(options) {
  let target = null, last = null;
  const toLine = (hit, y) => {
    const index = options.indexOf(hit.row);
    if (index < 0 || !target) return;
    target.precise = true;
    options.scroll({ index, animated: true, ...hitScroll(y, options.visible()) });
  };
  return {
    /** A new jump to `hit` (a new query, 上一处 / 下一处). True while its line waits to be measured: call `toRow` after a moment. */
    jump(hit) {
      const key = hitKey(hit);
      target = { key, precise: false };
      if (last?.key === key) {
        toLine(hit, last.y);
        return false;
      }
      last = null;
      return true;
    },
    /** Nothing measured in time (its row is not rendered, or the hit is not in a block that measures): to its row. */
    toRow(hit) {
      if (!target || target.key !== hitKey(hit) || target.precise) return;
      const index = options.indexOf(hit.row);
      if (index >= 0) options.scroll({ index, animated: true, viewPosition: 0.25 });
    },
    /** The view measured `hit`'s line `y` px below the top of its row. */
    measured(hit, y) {
      const key = hitKey(hit);
      last = { key, y };
      if (target?.key === key && !target.precise) toLine(hit, y);
    }
  };
}

  return { summary: view.summary, next: view.next, reply: fresh ? view.reply : null, at: view.at, runner: view.runner, state: updating ? "updating" : fresh ? "fresh" : "stale" };
}

function aiReply(suggestion, rules) {

}
function mergeRecaps(previous, answer) {
  if (answer.mode === "unchanged") return previous ? { ...previous, revision: answer.revision } : { enabled: false, suggestions: false, revision: answer.revision, byAgent: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), busy: false };
  const byAgent = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const view of answer.recaps) {
    const before = previous?.byAgent.get(view.agentId);
    byAgent.set(view.agentId, before && JSON.stringify(before) === JSON.stringify(view) ? before : view);
  }
  return { enabled: answer.enabled, suggestions: answer.suggestions, revision: answer.revision, byAgent, busy: answer.recaps.some((view) => view.state !== "idle") };
}

var RESTORE_STILL_RUNNING = t2("sharedHistory.m001");
var RESTORE_DISCONNECTED = t2("sharedHistory.m002");
var RESTORE_RELOADING = t2("sharedHistory.m003");
var errorText3 = (error) => (error instanceof Error ? error.message : typeof error === "string" ? error : "").trim();
var timedOut = (message) => /timed? ?out|timeout|宿主未响应/i.test(message);
var disconnected = (message) => /not connected|disconnect|client (?:is )?closed|connection (?:closed|lost|reset)|socket|Plugin stopped/i.test(message);
var pluginGone = (message) => /Plugin is not available|does not contribute RPC/i.test(message);
function restoreFailureText(error) {
  const message = errorText3(error);
  if (timedOut(message)) return RESTORE_STILL_RUNNING;
  if (disconnected(message)) return RESTORE_DISCONNECTED;
  if (pluginGone(message)) return RESTORE_RELOADING;
  if (!message) return t2("sharedHistory.m004");
  return /[\u3400-\u9fff]/.test(message) ? message.replaceAll(t2("sharedHistory.m005"), t2("sharedHistory.m006")) : t2("sharedHistory.m007", { value1: message.slice(0, 300) });
}
var RESTORE_POLL_MS = 2500;
var RESTORE_FOLLOW_MS = 10 * 6e4;
function followRestore(flow) {
  return __async(this, null, function* () {
    const now = flow.now ?? Date.now, started = now();
    const base = { status: "pending", agentId: flow.agentId, workspaceId: null, workspaceRestored: false, workspaceAction: null, message: RESTORE_STILL_RUNNING, jobId: null };
    const still = (view2 = base) => ({ ...view2, status: "pending", message: RESTORE_STILL_RUNNING });
    const failed = (error, view2 = base) => {
      const message = errorText3(error);
      return timedOut(message) || disconnected(message) ? { ...still(view2), message: restoreFailureText(error) } : { ...view2, status: "failed", message: restoreFailureText(error) };
    };
    let view;
    try {
      view = yield flow.start();
    } catch (error) {
      return failed(error);
    }
    for (let misses = 0; view.status === "pending"; ) {
      if (!view.jobId) return still(view);
      flow.onProgress?.(view.message);
      if (!(yield flow.wait(RESTORE_POLL_MS))) return still(view);
      let next;
      try {
        next = yield flow.status(view.jobId);
        misses = 0;
      } catch (error) {
        const message = errorText3(error);
        if (pluginGone(message)) next = null;
        else if ((timedOut(message) || disconnected(message)) && ++misses < 3) continue;
        else return failed(error, view);
      }
      if (!next) {
        const archived = yield flow.archived?.().catch(() => null);
        if (archived === false) return { ...view, status: "already_active", message: t2("sharedHistory.m008") };
        if (archived === true) return { ...view, status: "failed", message: t2("sharedHistory.m009") };
        return still(view);
      }
      view = next;
      if (view.status === "pending" && now() - started >= RESTORE_FOLLOW_MS) return still(view);
    }
    return view;
  });
}

var import_plugin20 = require("@getpaseo/plugin");
var import_zod20 = require("zod");
addDefaults({ kitDeferred });
var SEND_NOUN_LIMIT = 80;
var DeferredViewSchema = import_zod20.z.object({
  messageId: import_zod20.z.string(),
  agentId: import_zod20.z.string(),
  /** What makes two messages the same request: one per agent and key is on its way at a time. */
  key: import_zod20.z.string(),
  source: import_zod20.z.string(),
  preview: import_zod20.z.string(),
  createdAt: import_zod20.z.number(),
  at: import_zod20.z.number(),
  state: import_zod20.z.enum(["queued", "held", "sending", "sent", "maybe-sent", "canceled", "discarded", "expired"]),
  note: import_zod20.z.string(),
  /** A scheduled message's time (UTC ms); only on messages queued with `notBefore`. */
  notBefore: import_zod20.z.number().optional()
});
var ConsentSchema = import_zod20.z.object({ interrupt: import_zod20.z.boolean(), approvals: import_zod20.z.array(import_zod20.z.string().max(200)).max(100), turn: import_zod20.z.string().max(300).nullable().optional() });
var DeferredGuardSchema = import_zod20.z.record(import_zod20.z.string().min(1).max(40), import_zod20.z.string().max(200).nullable()).refine((value) => Object.keys(value).length <= 8, "at most 8 conditions");
var DeferredSendResultSchema = import_zod20.z.union([
  /** sent, still sending, held for the user (failed or unknown outcome), or the same content already on its way. */
  import_zod20.z.object({ status: import_zod20.z.enum(["sent", "sending", "held", "existing"]), view: DeferredViewSchema }),
  /** What sending would do now needs the user's OK: ask `plan.confirm`, then send again with `consent`. */
  import_zod20.z.object({ status: import_zod20.z.literal("confirm"), plan: import_zod20.z.object({ label: import_zod20.z.string(), note: import_zod20.z.string(), confirm: import_zod20.z.string() }), consent: ConsentSchema }),
  /**
   * Nothing was sent: another send to the agent is going on (or the plugin could not check the message's `guard`), the agent
   * is archived or deleted, or the plugin's own condition for this message (`guard`) no longer holds.
   */
  import_zod20.z.object({ status: import_zod20.z.enum(["busy", "gone", "refused"]), message: import_zod20.z.string() })
]);
var sendKey = import_zod20.z.string().min(1).max(120);
function deferredSendContracts(prefix) {
  return {
    /**
     * Send now. The server plans again from the agent as it is and sends only if `consent` covers what that would do;
     * otherwise it answers "confirm". Retry with the same `messageId` after a lost answer: it never sends twice. `group`:
     * messages answering one question (one per group goes out; the others answer with it, "existing"); `guard`: the plugin's
     * own condition, checked right before the send ("refused" once it no longer holds).
     */
    send: (0, import_plugin20.defineRpc)({
      name: `${prefix}.deferred.send`,
      input: import_zod20.z.object({
        group: sendKey.optional(),
        guard: DeferredGuardSchema.optional(),
        agentId: import_zod20.z.string().min(1),
        text: import_zod20.z.string().min(1).max(2e5),
        messageId: import_zod20.z.string().min(8).max(100),
        source: import_zod20.z.string().max(200).optional(),
        key: sendKey.optional(),
        what: import_zod20.z.string().max(SEND_NOUN_LIMIT).optional(),
        consent: ConsentSchema.nullable().optional()
      }),
      output: DeferredSendResultSchema
    }),
    /**
     * Queue a message (or send it now if the agent is already free); the same `messageId` again returns its state.
     * Content already on its way (same agent and key), or the answer to its `group`, answers with that message under its own
     * id. A `guard` that no longer holds is answered with the message dropped (未发送, its note says why). `notBefore`
     * (UTC ms, at most a week ahead) schedules it: it is not delivered before that time.
     */
    enqueue: (0, import_plugin20.defineRpc)({
      name: `${prefix}.deferred.enqueue`,
      input: import_zod20.z.object({
        agentId: import_zod20.z.string().min(1),
        text: import_zod20.z.string().min(1).max(2e5),
        messageId: import_zod20.z.string().min(8).max(100),
        source: import_zod20.z.string().max(200).optional(),
        key: sendKey.optional(),
        group: sendKey.optional(),
        guard: DeferredGuardSchema.optional(),
        notBefore: import_zod20.z.number().int().positive().optional()
      }),
      output: DeferredViewSchema
    }),
    /** Queued, held and sending messages, plus the last half hour's outcomes; newest first. */
    list: (0, import_plugin20.defineRpc)({ name: `${prefix}.deferred.list`, input: import_zod20.z.object({ agentId: import_zod20.z.string().optional() }), output: import_zod20.z.array(DeferredViewSchema) }),
    cancel: (0, import_plugin20.defineRpc)({ name: `${prefix}.deferred.cancel`, input: import_zod20.z.object({ messageId: import_zod20.z.string().min(1) }), output: DeferredViewSchema.nullable() }),
    /**
     * Send a held message anyway (same id and options, once the agent is free). `now`: a scheduled message goes without
     * waiting for its time (立即发送); without it a scheduled message keeps its time.
     */
    resume: (0, import_plugin20.defineRpc)({ name: `${prefix}.deferred.resume`, input: import_zod20.z.object({ messageId: import_zod20.z.string().min(1), now: import_zod20.z.boolean().optional() }), output: DeferredViewSchema.nullable() })
  };
}
function isScheduled(view, now = Date.now()) {
  return view.state === "queued" && typeof view.notBefore === "number" && view.notBefore > now;
}
function isOnItsWay(view) {
  return view.state === "queued" || view.state === "held" || view.state === "sending";
}
function onItsWay(views, agentId, key) {
  return views?.find((view) => view.agentId === agentId && view.key === key && isOnItsWay(view)) ?? null;
}
function deferOffer(agent, plan) {
  if (!agent || plan.kind !== "confirm") return null;
  const approval = (agent.pendingPermissions ?? 0) > 0 || agent.requiresAttention === true && agent.attentionReason === "permission";
  return approval ? { label: t("kitDeferred.afterApprovalLabel"), note: t("kitDeferred.afterApprovalNote") } : { label: t("kitDeferred.afterTurnLabel"), note: t("kitDeferred.afterTurnNote") };
}
function deferredBadge(view) {
  switch (view.state) {
    case "queued":
      return { label: t("kitDeferred.queued"), tone: "warning" };
    case "held":
      return { label: t("kitDeferred.held"), tone: "orange" };
    case "sending":
      return { label: t("kitDeferred.sending"), tone: "warning" };
    case "sent":
      return { label: t("kitDeferred.sent"), tone: "success" };
    case "maybe-sent":
      return { label: t("kitDeferred.maybeSent"), tone: "warning" };
    case "canceled":
      return { label: t("kitDeferred.canceled"), tone: "neutral" };

function subtaskForest(items, idOf, parentOf) {
  const map = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const item of items) map.set(idOf(item), { item, children: [], broken: false });
  const parents = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const [id4, node] of map) {
    const parent = parentOf(node.item);
    parents.set(id4, parent && map.has(parent) ? parent : null);
  }
  const visited = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const id4 of map.keys()) {
    if (visited.has(id4)) continue;
    let cursor = id4;
    const chain = [];
    const local = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    while (cursor && !visited.has(cursor)) {
      if (local.has(cursor)) {
        parents.set(cursor, null);
        map.get(cursor).broken = true;
        break;
      }
      local.add(cursor);
      chain.push(cursor);
      cursor = parents.get(cursor) ?? null;
    }
    for (const key of chain) visited.add(key);
  }
  const roots = [];
  for (const [id4, node] of map) {
    const parent = parents.get(id4);
    if (parent) map.get(parent).children.push(node);
    else roots.push(node);
  }
  return roots;
}
function flattenSubtasks(roots, collapsed, idOf) {
  const rows = [];
  const stack = roots.slice().reverse().map((node) => ({ node, depth: 0 }));
  while (stack.length) {
    const { node, depth } = stack.pop();
    rows.push({ item: node.item, depth, children: node.children.length, broken: node.broken });
    if (!collapsed.has(idOf(node.item))) for (let i = node.children.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) stack.push({ node: node.children[i], depth: depth + 1 });
  }
  return rows;
}

// shared/evidence.ts
function excerptText(text4, limit) {
  const cap = Math.max(0, Math.floor(limit));
  if (text4.length <= cap) return { text: text4, truncated: false };
  if (cap < 80) return { text: text4.slice(0, Math.ceil(cap * 0.6)) + text4.slice(-Math.floor(cap * 0.4)), truncated: true };
  const marker = t2("sharedEvidence.m001", { value1: text4.length });
  const head = Math.ceil((cap - marker.length) * 0.55);
  return { text: text4.slice(0, head) + marker + text4.slice(-(cap - marker.length - head)), truncated: true };
}

function nativeChildResult(parentId, child, tail, headRaw) {

  const latest = rows.slice(lastUserIndex + 1).findLast((row) => row.item.type === "assistant_message" && string(row.item.text).trim());

  };

  const firstInputConfirmed = !!firstInput && originKnown && sameEpoch;

function merge(previous, incoming, direction = "tail") {

  });

function createTimelineCache(options = {}) {
  const entries = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const limit = options.limit ?? 12, maxBytes = options.maxBytes ?? 24 * 1024 * 1024;
  const prune = (protectedKey) => {
    let bytes = [...entries.values()].reduce((sum, store) => sum + store.bytes, 0);
    for (const [key, store] of entries) {
      if (entries.size <= limit && bytes <= maxBytes) break;
      if (key === protectedKey || store.active) continue;
      const size = store.bytes;
      if (store.dispose()) {
        entries.delete(key);
        bytes -= size;
      }
    }
  };
  return { get(key, create) {
    let store = entries.get(key);
    if (store) entries.delete(key);
    else store = create(() => prune(key));
    entries.set(key, store);
    prune(key);
    return store;
  }, get size() {
    return entries.size;
  } };
}

function fallbackHeadline(overview) {
  const { totals, health: h } = overview;
  if (!totals.reports) return t2("coreInsightsOverview.noAnalysisReportsInTheLastDays", { value1: overview.days });
  const parts = [t2("coreInsightsOverview.reportsCoverAgents", { count: totals.reports, value2: totals.agents })];
  if (h.blocked) parts.push(t2("coreInsightsOverview.reportsShowBlockers", { value1: h.blocked }));
  parts.push(totals.openFindings ? t2("coreInsightsOverview.issuesNeedAttention", { value1: totals.openFindings }) : t2("coreInsightsOverview.noIssuesNeedAttention"));
  return parts.join(t2("coreInsightsOverview.message"));
}

function historyLabel(item, history) {
  const day3 = (value) => new Date(value).toLocaleDateString(currentLanguage(), { month: "numeric", day: "numeric" });
  const shared3 = history.some((other) => other.id !== item.id && other.status === "completed" && day3(other.createdAt) === day3(item.createdAt));
  return shared3 ? `${day3(item.createdAt)} ${new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString(currentLanguage(), { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false })}` : day3(item.createdAt);
}

  if (busyStatuses.includes(job.status)) return "info";
  if (job.status === "failed") return "danger";

// shared/digest-view.ts
function buildTimeAxis(spans, width, options = {}) {
  const gapMs = options.gapMs ?? 12e4, breakWidth = options.breakWidth ?? 18, minPieceWidth = options.minPieceWidth ?? 16;
  const sorted = spans.filter((span) => Number.isFinite(span.start) && Number.isFinite(span.end)).map((span) => ({ start: span.start, end: Math.max(span.start, span.end) })).sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
  const clusters = [];
  for (const span of sorted) {
    const last = clusters.at(-1);
    if (last && span.start - last.end <= gapMs) last.end = Math.max(last.end, span.end);
    else clusters.push({ ...span });
  }
  if (!clusters.length || width <= 0) return { pieces: [], breaks: [], width: Math.max(0, width), x: () => 0 };
  const breaks = clusters.length - 1, available = Math.max(0, width - breaks * breakWidth);
  const durations = clusters.map((cluster) => Math.max(1, cluster.end - cluster.start)), total = durations.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const minimum = Math.min(minPieceWidth, available / clusters.length), spare = Math.max(0, available - minimum * clusters.length);
  const pieces = [], gaps = [];
  let x = 0;
  clusters.forEach((cluster, index) => {
    const pieceWidth = minimum + spare * durations[index] / total;
    pieces.push({ from: cluster.start, to: cluster.end, x, width: pieceWidth });
    x += pieceWidth;
    if (index < clusters.length - 1) {
      gaps.push({ x, width: breakWidth, ms: clusters[index + 1].start - cluster.end });
      x += breakWidth;
    }
  });
  const map = (at2) => {
    let piece = pieces[0];
    for (const candidate of pieces) {
      if (at2 >= candidate.from) piece = candidate;
      else break;
    }
    if (at2 > piece.to) return piece.x + piece.width;
    const span = piece.to - piece.from;
    return piece.x + (span > 0 ? Math.max(0, at2 - piece.from) / span * piece.width : 0);
  };
  return { pieces, breaks: gaps, width, x: map };
}
var LANE_ORDER = ["model", "read", "search", "edit", "shell", "web", "agent", "plan", "wait", "other"];
function lanesIn(segments) {
  const present = new Set(segments.map((segment) => segment.lane));
  return LANE_ORDER.filter((lane) => present.has(lane));
}
function segmentsBetween(segments, from, to) {
  return segments.filter((segment) => segment.end >= from && segment.start <= to).map((segment) => ({ ...segment, start: Math.max(from, segment.start), end: Math.min(to, segment.end) }));
}
function shareEntries(share2) {
  const entries = Object.entries(share2).filter(([, ms2]) => ms2 > 0);
  const total = entries.reduce((sum, [, ms2]) => sum + ms2, 0);
  return entries.sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([lane, ms2]) => ({ lane, ms: ms2, fraction: total ? ms2 / total : 0 }));
}
var turnSpan = (turn, now) => ({ start: turn.start, end: turn.end ?? Math.max(turn.start, now) });
function splitPath(path) {
  const index = path.lastIndexOf("/");
  return index < 0 ? { dir: "", name: path } : { dir: path.slice(0, index + 1), name: path.slice(index + 1) };
}

function quotaWindowReset2(accounts, base, now) {

function cacheLook(entry, now) {
  if (entry.cold) return { state: "cold", left: 0, reason: entry.cold };
  const left = Date.parse(entry.expiresAt ?? "") - now;
  if (!Number.isFinite(left) || left <= 0) return { state: "cold", left: 0, reason: "expired" };
  return { state: left <= (entry.ttl === "1h" ? 5 : 1) * 6e4 ? "ending" : "warm", left, reason: null };
}
function cacheText(look) {
  if (look.state === "cold") return t2("alertsCache.cold");
  return look.left >= 6e4 ? t2("alertsCache.minutes", { count: Math.ceil(look.left / 6e4) }) : t2("alertsCache.seconds", { count: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(look.left / 1e3)) });
}
function nextCacheChange(entry, now) {
  const look = cacheLook(entry, now);
  if (look.state === "cold") return null;
  if (look.left <= 6e4) return look.left % 1e3 || 1e3;
  const warn = (entry.ttl === "1h" ? 5 : 1) * 6e4, toMinute = look.left % 6e4 || 6e4;
  return look.state === "warm" && look.left - warn < toMinute ? look.left - warn : toMinute;
}

var ends = { turn_completed: "completed", turn_failed: "failed", turn_canceled: "canceled" };
function eventAgentTitle(event, titles2) {
  return titles2?.get(event.agentId) || event.agentTitle;

function buildSwimlanes(events, live2, now, windowMs, limit, titles2) {
  const from = now - windowMs;
  const byAgent = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const sorted = [...events].sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a.at) - Date.parse(b.at));
  for (const event of sorted) {
    const at2 = Date.parse(event.at);
    if (!Number.isFinite(at2)) continue;
    const state = byAgent.get(event.agentId) ?? { title: eventAgentTitle(event, titles2), spans: [] };
    state.title = eventAgentTitle(event, titles2);
    byAgent.set(event.agentId, state);
    const kind = ends[event.type];
    if (event.type === "turn_started") state.turn = at2;
    else if (kind) {
      state.spans.push({ start: state.turn ?? at2 - (event.durationMs ?? 0), end: at2, kind, open: false });
      state.turn = void 0;
    } else if (event.type === "permission_requested") state.approval ?? (state.approval = at2);
    else if (event.type === "permission_resolved" && state.approval !== void 0) {
      state.spans.push({ start: state.approval, end: at2, kind: "approval", open: false });
      state.approval = void 0;
    }
  }
  const lanes = [];
  for (const [agentId, state] of byAgent) {
    const status = live2.get(agentId);
    if (state.turn !== void 0 && status) state.spans.push({ start: state.turn, end: now, kind: "running", open: true });
    if (state.approval !== void 0 && status === "waiting") state.spans.push({ start: state.approval, end: now, kind: "approval", open: true });
    const spans = state.spans.filter((span) => span.end >= from && span.start <= now).map((span) => ({ ...span, start: Math.max(from, span.start), end: Math.min(now, Math.max(span.start, span.end)) }));
    if (spans.length) lanes.push({ agentId, title: state.title || agentId, spans, lastAt: Math.max(...spans.map((span) => span.end)) });
  }
  const edges = lanes.flatMap((lane) => lane.spans.filter((span) => span.kind !== "approval").flatMap((span) => [[span.start, 1], [span.end, -1]])).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]);
  let current2 = 0, peak = 0, peakAt = null;
  for (const [at2, change] of edges) {
    current2 += change;
    if (current2 > peak) {
      peak = current2;
      peakAt = at2;
    }
  }
  const turns = lanes.reduce((sum, lane) => sum + lane.spans.filter((span) => span.kind !== "approval").length, 0);
  const shown = [...lanes].sort((a, b) => b.lastAt - a.lastAt).slice(0, limit).sort((a, b) => Math.min(...a.spans.map((span) => span.start)) - Math.min(...b.spans.map((span) => span.start)) || a.agentId.localeCompare(b.agentId));
  return { lanes: shown, peak, peakAt, turns, hidden: lanes.length - shown.length };
}
function swimTicks(now, windowMs, utcOffsetMinutes) {
  const step = windowMs <= 36e5 ? 9e5 : windowMs <= 6 * 36e5 ? 36e5 : 4 * 36e5;
  const offset2 = utcOffsetMinutes * 6e4, from = now - windowMs;
  const ticks = [];
  for (let tick = Math.ceil((from + offset2) / step) * step - offset2; tick <= now; tick += step) ticks.push(tick);
  return ticks;
}

function winner(metric, a, b) {
  const left = metric.value(a), right = metric.value(b);
  if (metric.better === "none" || left === null || right === null || metric.format(left) === metric.format(right)) return null;
  return metric.better === "high" === left > right ? 0 : 1;
}

function radarScore(axis, row, other) {
  const mine = axis.value(row), theirs = axis.value(other);
  if (mine === null) return 0.1;
  if (theirs === null) return 1;
  const ratio = axis.better === "high" ? Math.max(mine, theirs) > 0 ? mine / Math.max(mine, theirs) : 1 : mine > 0 ? Math.min(mine, theirs) / mine : 1;
  return 0.1 + 0.9 * Math.sqrt(ratio);
}

function agentTimeLabel(agent, now) {
  return agent.activeTurnStartedAt ? shortDuration(Math.max(0, now - Date.parse(agent.activeTurnStartedAt))) : relativeTime(agent.lastActivityAt || agent.updatedAt || agent.createdAt, now);
}
function countDescendants(row, match) {
  let count6 = 0;
  const stack = [...row.node.children];
  while (stack.length) {
    const child = stack.pop();
    if (match(child.agent)) count6++;
    stack.push(...child.children);
  }
  return count6;
}

            timeLabel: agentTimeLabel(item.row.node.agent, now),
            signal: signals.get(id4),
            rate: rates?.get(id4),
            heartbeats: beats,
            recap: recaps?.get(id4) ?? null,
            day: item.row.node.agent.stop ? now : dayOf(now),
            marked: marked2?.has(id4) ?? false,
            delegatedFrom: from ? hostLabels.get(from) ?? "" : null,
            onToggle,
            onSelect
          }
        );
      }
    }
  );
}
var dayOf = (now) => {
  const date = new Date(now);
  return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()).getTime();
};
